title: The Sharper of Alexandria and the Chief of Police
logline: A soldier is robbed of 1000 gold pieces at an Alexandria inn; as the police chief prepares to beat the innocent guests, a sharper confesses, returns the purse, and then steals it again in front of everyone while pretending to show how he did it.
moral: A hasty, heavy-handed judge is easily made a fool of; the innocent are spared not by justice but by a rogue's vanity.
tone: Light caper comedy with one real threat (the canes) that never lands. The sharper is a charming conjuror, the chief pompous, the soldier a proud man steadily deflated, the four guests a small chorus of distinct cowards.

beats.summary: The soldier checks his purse of 1000 gold pieces at the inn door; hidden eyes see it.
He wakes in the night: the bag is slit and the gold is gone.
The chief has every guest of the inn arrested, with no proof.
Morning: the canes are brought and tested in the air.
A stranger parts the crowd and stops the beating.
He draws the purse from his sleeve and puts it on the table.
His boast: the real skill is stealing it a second time.
Flashback: he saw the gold paid out in Cairo and followed it.
Flashback: the two-finger move that emptied the bag.
In the hall he repeats the move on the purse on the table.
Everyone leans in, sure the money is safe.
He snatches the purse and runs.
Into the pool, purse held high, and away through the lanes.
The guards come back with nothing.
The chief's ruling: recovered for a moment, case closed.
The soldier leaves empty-handed; the guests go free.
The sharper is gone and the chief is left with the scandal.

props.description: The planned fat coin purse: 70 wide x 80 tall at s 1, red leather with red-dot shading, yellow drawstring neck, two string ends; fields sq, swing, glint. The star prop: it must read at phone size, so never draw it under 60 px on screen when it matters.

The soldier's bag: brown leather satchel 150 x 110 with a buckled flap and a shoulder strap. Fields: bulge 0..1 (1 = purse inside, 0 = limp), slit 0..1 (a diagonal cut 90 long on the front with a triangular flap hanging down and dark inside), swing, upside (turned over).
The planned stick, as a tied bundle of 7 canes (each 230 x 8, ochre) and one loose cane that bends (curve field) and whips. Never touches anyone.

Stone-rimmed pool sunk in the ground: 380 wide, rim blocks 40 wide x 26 high above ground, water surface 5 below ground level, blue with white dot shading and two ripple lines; back and front passes so a figure can be clipped at the water line.
Hanging board 120 x 70 on an iron bracket with the word INN (Bangers) and a small bed pictogram; swings.

subtitles.ar: دخل جندي مدينة الإسكندرية ونزل في خان للمسافرين،|وكان يحمل كيسًا فيه ألف قطعة ذهبية.|نام بعض الليل، ثم استيقظ ليجد حقيبته ممزقة والمال مسروقًا.|أسرع إلى رئيس الشرطة حسام الدين يشكو ما حدث.
subtitles.en: A soldier arrived in Alexandria|with a purse of a thousand gold pieces.|Overnight someone cut open his saddlebags and stole it,|so he complained to Husam al-Din, the police chief.

subtitles.ar: أمر رئيس الشرطة بالقبض على جميع من كانوا في الخان،|مع أنهم لم يُتهموا بدليل واضح.|وفي الصباح أحضر العصي استعدادًا لضربهم حتى يعترف أحدهم،|بينما وقف الجندي ينتظر استعادة نقوده.
subtitles.en: The chief detained everyone at the inn|and prepared to beat them|into a confession,|despite lacking proof against any one guest.

subtitles.ar: قبل بدء الضرب شق رجل طريقه بين الحاضرين|وصاح: دعوا هؤلاء الأبرياء، فأنا الذي أخذت المال!|أخرج كيس الذهب من كمه ووضعه أمام رئيس الشرطة والجندي،|فتنفس المسافرون المحبوسون الصعداء.
subtitles.en: Before the beating began,|a stranger stepped forward, confessed,|and placed the purse before the chief.|The detained travelers were relieved.

subtitles.ar: أثنى الناس على اعتراف الرجل،|لكنه قال إن براعته الحقيقية ليست في إعادة المال،|بل في سرقته مرة ثانية.|سأله رئيس الشرطة بدهشة كيف فعل ذلك، فبدأ المحتال يروي طريقته من البداية.
subtitles.en: People praised the confession,|but the man boasted that his cleverest feat|was stealing the purse a second time.|The chief demanded an explanation.

subtitles.ar: قال المحتال إنه رأى الجندي يستلم الذهب في سوق الصيارفة بالقاهرة.|تبعه من مدينة إلى أخرى دون أن يجد فرصة للسرقة،|حتى نزل معه في خان الإسكندرية وراقبه إلى أن غلبه النوم.
subtitles.en: The trickster said he had watched the soldier receive the gold in Cairo|and followed him from town to town,|waiting for an opportunity.

subtitles.ar: شرح كيف شق حقيبة الجندي ليلًا وأخذ المال بهدوء.|ثم مد يده نحو الكيس الموضوع على الطاولة وقال إنه سيُريهم الحركة نفسها.|اقترب الجميع ليتابعوا العرض،|وهم يظنون أن المال أصبح في أمان.
subtitles.en: He described cutting the sleeping soldier’s bag.|Pretending to demonstrate the theft,|he reached for the purse|lying openly before them.

subtitles.ar: أمسك الكيس فجأة واندفع خارج المجلس،|ثم قفز في بركة ماء قريبة|وفر عبر أزقة الإسكندرية المتصلة.|صرخ رئيس الشرطة يأمر بملاحقته، لكن الرجال تأخروا، وعادوا من دون المحتال أو المال.
subtitles.en: Suddenly he grabbed the purse, ran outside,|plunged into a nearby pool,|and escaped through Alexandria’s interconnected lanes.|The officers failed to catch him.

subtitles.ar: قال رئيس الشرطة للجندي إنه وجد اللص واستعاد ماله للحظة،|ولذلك لم يعد يستطيع مطالبة أهل الخان بشيء.|خرج الجندي خالي اليدين، ونجا المسافرون من الضرب.|أما المحتال فهرب، تاركًا خلفه فضيحة لرئيس الشرطة.
subtitles.en: The chief insisted the soldier had briefly recovered his money|and could not blame the inn guests.|The soldier lost his gold, the innocents were spared,|and the thief escaped.

new_assets.name: person costume presets (soldier)
new_assets.description: The planned soldier / guard preset (AN-087, AN-097): pointed helmet with nose bar and neck cloth, knee tunic, wide belt, round chest plate, boots; pal red for the hero soldier, blue for the two police guards; helmet scale option for the short guard.
new_assets.implementation: Add a COSTUME entry in cast/people.js like the existing presets: helmet = half ellipse + triangle point + nose bar rect + cloth quad; chest plate = disc with dot shading. Opt-in, so the regression test stays identical.

new_assets.name: purse
new_assets.implementation: One closed bezier body with K dot shading, a pinched neck, two short string strokes; scale y by sq about its base; optional glint star.

new_assets.name: saddlebag
new_assets.description: Leather satchel with bulge, slit and upside fields (see props). Reusable for any traveller, messenger or thief story.
new_assets.implementation: Rounded rect body whose belly width follows bulge; flap as a second rounded shape with a buckle; slit = a dark lens shape plus a triangle flap rotated by slit; strap as a brush line to the shoulder point.

new_assets.name: stick, coinPile, balanceScale, padlock, hourglass, moth
new_assets.description: Planned small props reused under their planned names: stick (as stickBundle with one bending cane), coinPile and balanceScale on the money changer's counter, padlock in the SAFE thought cloud, hourglass in the ruling balloon, moth from the empty bag.
new_assets.implementation: Each a small flat-shape function as described by the earlier plans; the cane bend is a quadratic curve with a curve field driven by swing().

new_assets.name: poolBasin
new_assets.description: Stone-rimmed sunk pool with back and front passes (see props). Reusable for any courtyard, garden or bath scene.
new_assets.implementation: Back pass: far rim blocks and the water rect; front pass: near rim blocks. The swimmer is drawn between the passes inside a clip rect above the water line (the Fox head-into-hole clip technique). Ripples with the Library ripple helper.

new_assets.name: lanesYard
new_assets.description: Courtyard between a hall door, a pool and a wall with three connected lane mouths and a walkable roof line (see sets). Reusable as any town yard or chase exit; the lane mouths alone serve any alley gag.
new_assets.implementation: Bake sky + townFarCity skyline + a townWall-style wall; cut the lane mouths with townArchPts filled NAVY2 plus a thin lit sliver; townDoor for the hall door; laundry line as a sagging curve with five cloth quads on swing(); front pass redraws the wall pieces between the mouths so runners vanish inside.

new_assets.name: dream wash
new_assets.description: Planned blue halftone corner vignette marking the told flashback (S10 to S13), strength 1 at the dissolves and 0.35 while it plays, with a small ribbon HIS STORY.
new_assets.implementation: Panel-space overlay: four corner radial dot fields in blue, alpha by strength; drawn before finish.

new_assets.name: iconBalloon
new_assets.description: Planned wordless picture balloon: single mode (no proof, giving back crossed out, x2, no chance) and a three-frame strip for the ruling (thief tick, purse tick, hourglass).
new_assets.implementation: Rounded paper box with a tail and a callback per frame; pop by scale with overshoot; ticks and X as two brush strokes.

new_assets.name: splash
new_assets.description: Planned crown of drops with rings for the plunge at 137.66 and the drips after.
new_assets.implementation: Seeded drops on ballistic arcs from the entry point plus two expanding ellipses on the water line.

new_assets.name: coinEyes, flush
new_assets.description: Planned coinEyes for the sharper at 92.36 and planned flush for the sharper at 99.98 and the chief at 143.7 and 175.72.
new_assets.implementation: As planned: gold discs over the pupils; red dot field clipped to the face rising with a 0..1 level and two steam puffs.

new_assets.name: sneak, runInPlace, bumpChain
new_assets.description: Planned motions: tiptoe gait for walk() (S10, S11, S13, S20), the comic wind up before a dash (S2, S16), and the concertina of a stopped line (S4) reused for the ring of leaners collapsing (S16).
new_assets.implementation: sneak: walk() option with higher knee lift and a 0.12 s hold at each toe contact, phase still from distance. runInPlace: leg phase from time for 0.35 s with dustBurst, then hand over to walk(X). bumpChain: per-member delay and a lurch() on the stop.

owner_questions: A title card THE SHARPER OF ALEXANDRIA is shown over the first 2.4 s of the street; default: shown.
The beating is only threatened: canes are brought, bent and swished in the air but never touch anyone; default: kept this soft.
The flashback shows a small blade slitting the bag (no person is threatened); default: blade shown for about 1.5 s.
The sharper is planted before the script introduces him (eyes behind a stall at 9.0, one eye and a shadow arm at 11.8, a yellow turban passing the door at 44.1); default: planted.
The soldier travels on foot with a shoulder bag (the Arabic says his bag; the English says saddlebags), so no horse is drawn; default: no horse.
The arrests are staged at night and the canes the next morning, following the Arabic (the English summary does not say when); default: night, with a NEXT MORNING... card.

Invented English lettering: GONE!, ARREST THEM ALL!, NO PROOF!, STOP!, I TOOK IT!, PHEW!, STEALING IT TWICE!, HOW?!, LIKE THIS..., YOINK!, SPLASH!, AFTER HIM!, TOO LATE!, CASE CLOSED!, WHAT A SCANDAL!; default: all kept.

Additions beyond the script for comedy: the purse held dry above the pool, the guards swapping lanes and colliding, a moth from the empty bag, the chief hiding under his turban at the end; default: kept.
implementation_notes: Use timing.json word starts for every cue (w(p, n)); the cue times in this plan are those starts. The narration is almost continuous: the only pauses of 0.2 s or more are 23.74-23.97, 95.36-95.58, 114.84-115.12, 142.56-143.02, 165.36-165.84 and after 178.06.

Sound: keep every effect under 0.15 s and very quiet (master 0.6 and low gain). Effects not in one of the listed pauses sit exactly on a word boundary at a sentence end; if one is audible over the voice, drop it rather than move it into a word.
The purse is on the low table from 58.56 to 130.82 in every hall shot; check continuity in each framing. From 57.9 a 1000 counter may sit near it only in S7.

Setup and payoff: the two-finger lift at 113.08 (flashback) and 121.1 (hall) must be the same pose from arm angles (not hand targets near the head), and the S2 and S13 bag close-ups must share one camera framing and one slit shape.
S2: the sharper is only an eye and a black arm silhouette. Do not light the right half of the room until S12.
S15: keep the door arch in frame and the lane from the sharper to the door empty; his gaze flicks to the door are 2-frame saccades (gazePlan ease 0.07).
Group reactions: stagger(i) by 3 to 4 frames, different gesture per guest (A nervous, B calm, C indignant, D cheeky); guards: B always a beat after A.
Screen direction: the hall door is on the left, so the escape runs right to left in the hall and continues right to left in lanesYard (hall door on the right there).
Flashback S10 to S13: dream wash corners at 0.35 plus the ribbon; the same soldier, bag and inn room drawings as S1 and S2, so the audience recognises the night.
Sets: call marketStreet, palaceHall, hutRoom and desertRoad once per option set (they bake); take positions from the returned anchors, not from the numbers here where the plan says approximate.
Panel-only shake for the snatch (130.82) and the collision (150.4); the caption panel never moves. Call finish last every frame.
Three chunks are 13 Arabic words long (P4 chunk 4, P6 chunk 2, P7 chunk 4): allow three lines or reduce the size slightly for those chunks; never trim the text.
LIFE.t = t for automatic blinks; give explicit lids hand blinks; no blink during held shock (17.5, 81.3, 159.9).
warnings: The English is a condensed translation: it omits the soldier waiting (P2), the inn and the watching (P5), the crowd drawing near (P6), the chief's order and the scandal (P7, P8). Both texts are kept verbatim; chunk meanings therefore do not always line up.
There are almost no pauses in the narration, so sound effects must be few and very soft (see implementation notes).
The soldier/guard costume preset is planned but not yet in the Library; it is the largest new drawing here.
Up to nine people share the hall in S5 to S9 and S14 to S20: use two depth rows (y 870 and y 930), s 0.78 to 0.9, and check that no lettering or balloon covers a face.
S11 is dense (palm, wall and a full day and night in 6.5 s); if it reads as rushed, drop the palm gag and keep the wall.
Coordinator 2026-11-16: capped at the 3-minute limit (end_hold 3.5 -> 1.73 s; 3 times past 180 s pulled to 179.9).
